description: Configuration and infrastructure: the config token, an hourly infrastructure health tick, and one command lane that runs Hermann's setup processes (health, git host provisioning, repository creation, bootstrap) as one-off scripts. The declared outputs are the places those scripts write through master.

places.p-hermann-config: Hermann config (seeded, edited in the app)
places.p-hermann-goal: Goal and principles (seeded placeholder, edited in the app)
places.p-hermann-setup-cmd: Setup commands: health, provision, create-repo, bootstrap
places.p-hermann-journal: Journal: every lane writes what it did

transitions.label: Infrastructure health tick (hourly)
transitions.description: Every hour, file a health command so p-hermann-infra always holds a fresh measurement of what the executor host can do. The goal and the cards are read optionally so the canvas shows where they enter the net.

transitions.label: Run a setup process
transitions.description: Executes one setup command token on the executor host: hermann-infra health, hermann-git provision|create-repo|protect, hermann-bootstrap bootstrap. The git host token (GITEA_TOKEN) is injected from the vault into this lane's environment.
